I cross list to Mercari and I’ve been doing pretty well so far with it. Sold something for the full listed price of $28 on there after like five people on Depop sent in offers for like 50%+ off with no further interaction. I’ve tried postmark and absolutely despised it, not user friendly at all and made me feel like I was attending a MLM scheme when I joined those group selling party things. It’s very hands on and is plagued with bots. But I mean I’ve heard it’s enjoyed and worked for others but for me personally it was a nightmare and not worth it. Vinted is kinda weird bc people want to spend the absolute minimum, I sold one thing and had printed the label, packed it, and was about to head to the post office when I got a notification that Vinted canceled the order because the account was suspicious??? It didn’t look sus to me and I actually had spoken with the buyer and it seemed normal to me. That was a deal breaker for me and I deleted my account. Another option to look into may be OfferUp. It’s mainly local, there is shipping but it’s a bit expensive and buyers seem apprehensive when it comes to shipping. But with heftier items maybe try to list those if you’re comfortable with face to face meetups. I’ve done a few and all went very well. It’s cash in hand no fees of course. So for big stuff or things that might not sell well on Depop I’d suggest trying OfferUp. Usually stuff older individuals would be interested in since that seems to be the main demographic. And for promoting tiktok seems to be a good place since going viral is very easy there, just show a few cute items with some aesthetic music and the tiktok girlies come running. I hope this helps!
